mapper.update: UPDATE equipment SET name = #{name}, brand = #{brand}, model = #{model}, storage_id = #{storageId}, type_id = #{typeId}, status = #{status}, current_user_id = #{currentUserId}, borrow_date = #{borrowDate}, expected_return_date = #{expectedReturnDate}, actual_return_date = #{actualReturnDate}, serial_number = #{serialNumber}, purchase_date = #{purchaseDate}, price = #{price}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT e.*, s.name AS storage_name, it.name AS type_name, ut.name AS current_user_name FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN storage s ON e.storage_id = s.id LEFT JOIN itemtype it ON e.type_id = it.id LEFT JOIN usertable ut ON e.current_user_id = ut.id WHERE e.id = #{id}
